text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered (P1) — serving-runtime pods in prod are CrashLoopBackOff on cluster us-west-2. Reason: SIGSEGV in runtime engine (vLLM/TensorRT fused kernels). Incident created: INC-2026-179876

pagerduty: paging on-call (mike) — see alert: https://pd.example/INC-2026-179876 :bell:

mike: acked. looking now. which service?

incident-bot: affected service: model-runner-prod (route: /v1/generate). ~40% of pods on node pool gpu-a100-48 are crashlooping. Crash count rising since 14:02 UTC. Error snippet attached to alert.

mike: I see CrashLoopBackOff. grabbing logs and recent deploy info.

mike: kubectl describe on a pod shows recent restarts with "signal 11 (SIGSEGV)" in container runtime. running `kubectl logs -c runner --previous`

mike: logs show repeated stack like:
```
2026-03-15T14:03:22Z ERROR runtime: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f8c1a2b3f44 sp 0x7ffd3c9b2008 error 4 in libvllm_kernel.so[7f8c19f00000+1b0000]
#0 0x7f8c1a2b3f44 in vllm::tensorrt::fused_attention::forward()
#1 0x7f8c1a2c4ab0 in vllm::infer::model_run()
```

eng-runtime: looks like a native segfault in a fused kernel (TensorRT custom plugin). Could be a driver/compat or a kernel regression from last rollout (image: redwood/runner:v2.14.0 -> v2.15.1).

sara: tagging eng-runtime on-call. Eng-runtime, can you confirm whether v2.15.1 introduced a fused op change?

eng-runtime: on it. quick check: our CI had a new fused-kernel optimization landed in 2.15.1 for attention caching. We're seeing similar stack traces in canary yesterday but low frequency. Need core dump to confirm.

mike: customers are hitting 500s. Routing layer shows ~15% error rate for /v1/generate across host group. I'm initiating fallback routing to the older model-version variant now (route -> runner:v2.14.0) to mitigate customer impact.

ops-bot: ran rollout override: set route policy model-runner-prod -> runner:v2.14.0 (stable) :white_check_mark:

customer-ops: FYI a few enterprise customers reported degraded latency/5xx. We're notifying affected accounts and pausing new ingestion for SSO flows.

mike: mitigation step 1 done: traffic shifted to v2.14.0. error rate dropped to baseline within ~2 min. leaving affected pods to collect data.

eng-runtime: we need core dumps from an affected pod. Please set ulimits and enable core collection on the node (temporary). Commands:
```
kubectl debug node/worker-12 --image=busybox -- bash
sudo sysctl -w kernel.core_pattern=/var/crash/core-%e-%p
sudo systemctl stop kubelet && ulimit -c unlimited && systemctl start kubelet
```
Collecting: `gdb -ex 'thread apply all bt full' -batch /usr/bin/runner core.<pid> > /tmp/core-backtrace.txt` and upload to s3://redwood-incidents/1798765432/

mike: doing that now on two nodes. cordoning node with highest restarts to avoid new pods scheduling there.

mike: `kubectl cordon worker-12` -> cordoned. draining non-critical pods. moving affected pods to healthy nodes to reproduce.

eng-runtime: thanks. also capture `nvidia-smi -q` and driver versions. If this is a driver mismatch combined with fused kernel, we might see segfaults only on certain driver builds.

mike: grabbing `nvidia-smi`
```
Driver Version: 535.86.05
CUDA Version: 12.1
GPU: A100-SXM4-80GB
```

eng-runtime: OK. matching expected. but the fused plugin uses cuBLASLt and custom kernel paths — could be race on cache invalidation. We'll instrument a build with extra checks. Need to reproduce with a smaller test harness.

sara: handoff: I'm taking over the incident for the next shift. Mike — can you summarize current state and next actions? :handshake:

mike: summary: traffic routed back to v2.14.0, customer impact reduced. 6 pods still crashlooping on nodes worker-12/13; we've cordoned worker-12 and collecting cores from one representative pod. eng-runtime building patched runner with extra bounds checks and disabling fused kernel by env flag `REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION=1` to test. next: deploy a canary runner:v2.15.1-fix1 with fused disabled and try warm-up. escalate if cores show memory corruption.

sara: ok. please attach core and backtrace link and a short incident timeline to the ticket. I'll keep paging until eng-runtime confirms fix. Also prep rollback plan if canary fails.

eng-runtime: patch pushed to internal CI: runner:v2.15.1-fix1 (fused disabled). requesting canary deploy to one pod set. configs:
```
env:
  - name: REDWOOD_DISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION
    value: "1"
```

ops-bot: canary rollout started: 1 pod -> runner:v2.15.1-fix1 in us-west-2 model-runner-prod-canary. :rocket:

eng-runtime: canary logs show no segfaults after 20 minutes, memory profile stable. request to promote fix and rebuild fused kernel with extra asserts.

sara: promoting patch across prod nodes after 30m verification window. notify customers and update incident timeline.

mike: promoted; observed stable since promotion. closing immediate P1. leaving incident open for root cause analysis and RCA write-up.

customer-ops: sending customer comms now with summary and ETA for RCA.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: Mitigated -> Monitoring. P1 -> P2. :white_check_mark:

sara: next actions for RCA: eng-runtime to analyze cores and PR with fused kernel safety checks; infra to add node-level kernel crash alerting and automated cordon for noisy nodes; devex to add a canary job that runs fused kernels under stress on driver matrix. Assigning owners: eng-runtime (root cause), eng-infra (alerting), devex (canary harness).

eng-runtime: acknowledged. will upload core/backtraces and open INC-1798765432-RCA within 24h.

mike: handing off monitoring to sara for next 12h. I'll be on call for follow-ups if needed.

sara: thanks team. closing thread for live mitigation; root cause and postmortem tracked in the RCA ticket. :memo:
